facts.text: Proposal: conversion of the integral garage to a bedroom, giving a four-bedroom house.
Driveway 11.0 m long by 5.5 m wide retained, accommodating two cars side by side.
Garage door replaced with a window and brick infill to match the existing house.
The applicant confirms the driveway will remain available for parking.

retrieved_policies.heading: Policy H3 Residential extensions
retrieved_policies.text: Extensions to dwellings are supported where: (a) the extension is subordinate in scale to the host dwelling; (b) materials match or complement the host dwelling; (c) there is no significant loss of light or outlook to a habitable room of a neighbouring dwelling, and a projection of more than 3.0 m beyond the rear wall of an attached neighbour is presumed to cause such loss; (d) at least 50 per cent of the private garden area is retained.

retrieved_policies.heading: Policy T2 Parking
retrieved_policies.text: Dwellings with three or more bedrooms shall retain at least two off-street parking spaces. Where a garage is converted or lost, equivalent replacement provision shall be shown and retained.

retrieved_policies.heading: Policy D1 Design quality
retrieved_policies.text: Development shall use external materials that complement the host building and the street. Where the materials are not specified on the drawings, a condition requiring samples to be agreed before the relevant works begin will be imposed.

reasons.finding: Two spaces remain on the 11.0 m by 5.5 m driveway (site-plan-J) for a four-bedroom house, so T2 is met provided they are retained.
Brick infill to match (elevation-K) complies with D1 and H3(b).

conditions.text: The two parking spaces on the driveway shown on site-plan-J shall be retained and kept available for parking.
